buildings.name: Wipro Tower 5
buildings.heightSource: Eleven approximately storey-spaced horizontal bands visible in the frontage; 3.8 m/storey is an estimate, not a measured height.
buildings.observed: Cream rendered massing, rounded green-tinted curtain-glass corner with pale horizontal bands, orange-red recessed balcony bays, and dark rectangular windows. Gate structures and trees hide much of the lower frontage.
buildings.unverified: Rear elevation, roof equipment, exact height, entrance and the long elevation behind trees. The curved corner is approximated by the mapped multi-edge footprint.

buildings.name: Ambuja Neotia EcoCentre
buildings.heightSource: Existing campus.json 17 floors, retained at the legacy 3.8 m/storey; not a surveyed height.
buildings.observed: Brick-red vertical strips, pale stone panels, blue-grey rectangular glazing, long vertical strips on the wings and stacked broad window panels in the central portion. Pale horizontal bands. No stepped mechanical crown visible from this view.
buildings.unverified: Rear elevation, roof equipment, exact height and floor count. Existing Overture outline retained; separate AltAir-labelled footprint has not been reconciled.

buildings.name: IIHM Global Campus
buildings.heightSource: Estimated from the two-storey entrance mass and the three-level central block visible behind it. Not a measured height.
buildings.observed: Off-white two-storey frontage, tall glazed side bays, recessed central glazed entrance, two pale columns under a broad canopy, a dark upper ribbon, and a narrower central upper block with vertical glazing.
buildings.unverified: Rear and side elevations, roof and exact height. Existing four-point survey footprint retained. The curved roof feature behind the frontage and flags are omitted because their geometry/anchors are uncertain.

buildings.name: PWC Office
buildings.heightSource: Approximate visual massing from the street frontage; no height tag in campus.json. Exact floor count obscured. The previous 12-storey glass tower was unsupported.
buildings.observed: White rendered facade and upper parapet, large lower green-tinted rectangular glazing, white mullions and an upper screened opening. Dark sign plates near entrance and roof. Trees obscure most of the long elevation.
buildings.unverified: Long sides, rear, exact height, footprint-to-building identity beyond the mapped label. Treat as a provisional frontage interpretation, not a measured reconstruction.

buildings.name: Hotel Monotel
buildings.heightSource: Eight approximately storey-spaced sections of the narrow front glazing in the observed view; 3.8 m/storey is an estimate, not a measured height.
buildings.observed: Broad largely blank tan stone front, narrow continuous vertical centre glazing with dark horizontal dividers, dark stone entrance piers and a broad canopy with a patterned underside. Low roof guardrail.
buildings.unverified: Rear and long sides, exact height, entrances beyond the visible front. Flags, plants and signs outside the footprint are not part of this building model.

buildings.name: Millennium City IT Park
buildings.heightSource: Twelve visible curtain-wall storey bands at an estimated 3.8 m per storey; not a measured height.
buildings.observed: Twin blue-grey curtain-glass wings with broad rounded street corners, slim pale horizontal floor bands, dark roof overhangs, a striped lower podium, a deep central entrance canopy, palms, a raised terrace and the low Burger King/Nizam's frontage along the street edge.
buildings.unverified: Rear elevations, roof equipment and exact height. The curved wings follow the mapped multi-edge footprint; curves are represented by its existing facets. Storefronts, palms and the entrance forecourt remain separate data-driven street objects.
